marketBrief.headline: Futures mixed as Fed decision and megacap earnings loom
marketBrief.summary: U.S. futures were mixed before the open while Asian chip stocks surged on SK Hynix's profit jump. Investors await the Fed's 2 p.m. ET decision, which is expected to leave rates unchanged, and Alphabet and Microsoft results after the close. Yesterday's Oct. 27 close and overnight moves are sourced from CNBC and the WSJ; futures levels are indicative only.
bullets: Business Insider (7:37 a.m. ET): Nasdaq 100 futures +0.44%, Dow futures -0.14%; quotes do not fully reconcile with the cash close.
WSJ: Kospi jumped 6% after SK Hynix's quarterly profit tripled; Nasdaq-100 futures gaining early Wednesday.
Treasury yields edged back above 5% ahead of the decision; Fed expected to hold after a hike last month.
Alphabet and Microsoft report after the close; AI spending, cloud growth and free cash flow are the focus.
Q3 GDP advance estimate and September personal income/outlays arrive Thursday, Oct. 29, at 8:30 a.m. ET.

calendar.why: The statement and press conference can move rate expectations, Treasury yields, the dollar and equity valuations.
